conceptZh: 戴尖耳朵、披紅斗篷的小玩具英雄爬上躺平的月亮想倒掛耍帥，結果月亮被他壓得立起來，他咻地滑到底、屁股著地、斗篷蓋住頭；腰帶上兩塊積木這時滑進來卡成中間兩橫，變出「月」。
object: a chunky cream crescent moon toy lying on its back, and a small boxy caped toy robot hero with pointed ears
morph: the crescent tips upright into the two outer strokes while two chunky bricks from the hero’s belt glide in from the left and click into the two short horizontal strokes of 月
creativeAngle: 第一次為「月」補上 prompt。把孩子喜歡的蝙蝠造型英雄做成無品牌的尖耳朵玩具機器人，用「耍帥失敗、滑下來跌坐」當笑點，同時讓月亮被壓得立起來就是形變本身。兩塊積木補中間兩橫，兼顧他喜歡的樂高元素。語音詞「月亮」的月與亮都只有一種讀音。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second 3D stylized toy animation as one continuous locked-off shot on a clean solid pale-lilac background. Centered lies a chunky cream-colored crescent moon toy resting on its back like a little hammock. From 0.4 seconds a small boxy toy robot hero with pointed ears, round friendly eyes and a short red cape struts in, climbs onto the crescent, and strikes an extremely dramatic pose with his cape flaring, trying to hang upside down from the tip. At 2.0 seconds his weight tips the crescent: it swings upright with a slow comic creak until it stands tall as the two outer strokes, and the tiny hero slides all the way down the inside of the curve and lands on his backside with a soft bonk, his cape flopping over his head. He peeks out from under the cape for a beat. At 3.2 seconds two chunky interlocking plastic bricks pop off his utility belt and glide in from the left, clicking into place one above the other inside the crescent to become the two short horizontal strokes. The hero gives a tiny satisfied thumbs-up and hops out of frame to the right by 4.7 seconds. By 5.0 seconds everything has resolved into one correctly formed Traditional Chinese character 月 in saturated deep indigo, perfectly centered and uncropped, filling about 70% of the frame height with generous margins on all sides, its long left stroke, hooked right stroke and two inner bars crisp and clearly separated. From 5.0 to 8.0 seconds the frame holds completely still on 月 with nothing else moving in the shot. Style: Pixar-like glossy chunky toy materials, soft studio lighting, bright high-contrast but not neon colors, no dark or moody night grading. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin and says exactly 「月、月、月亮」, using the reading ㄩㄝˋ for 月 both times and in the word. Speak the first 月 around 0.5 seconds, the second around 2.0 seconds, and 月亮 around 5.6 seconds during the still hold, with natural pauses, then stop; do not keep chanting the character or repeat the line. Keep the creak, bonk and brick clicks soft and clear of the voice, and use no music louder than the voice. The spoken word is audio only and must not appear as imagery. The only writing anywhere in the frame is the single character 月: no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no other letters, numbers, watermarks, scenery, extra props, particles, lens flare, motion blur on the glyph, or flashing effects.

conceptZh: 「月」變成低重力的月球停車場；小賽車想停在下方橫畫，卻衝過頭，慢悠悠翻到上方橫畫，四輪朝天還在轉。
object: A solid indigo 月 sculpture serving as a miniature lunar parking structure, with its two interior horizontal strokes as parking ledges.
morph: Begin with the complete, correctly formed glyph. Its strokes remain fixed while the race car makes an exaggerated low-gravity hop between the two interior ledges; the car exits before the final isolated glyph hold.
creativeAngle: 不再讓月牙立起來或插入積木，而是直接利用「月」的兩條內橫做上下停車層。愛衝過頭的回力賽車遇到月球低重力，竟然翻上樓，輪子空轉；字形全程穩定，笑點不會遮住筆畫。
promptEn:
Create an exactly 8-second stylized 3D toy animation in one locked frontal shot. Against a light warm-peach background, center one correctly formed Traditional Chinese glyph 月, rendered as a solid saturated-indigo sculpture occupying about 70% of frame height with generous margins. Preserve its standard four-stroke structure: the descending left stroke, the top horizontal turning into the right vertical hook, and two distinct interior horizontals. Use shallow extrusion so the interior horizontals can function as tiny parking ledges while the frontal silhouette remains unmistakable. This sculpture is the sole supporting object. Its subtly crater-dimpled surfaces and exaggerated lunar gravity make it a miniature moon playground; keep the dimples low contrast and away from stroke edges.

The lead is an original squeaky pull-back toy race car with a rounded tangerine plastic shell, tiny wheels and expressive googly eyes. It is confidently impatient, always braking too late. Keep it small enough to fit comfortably inside the glyph's openings. At 0.0–0.8 seconds, it sits near the left end of the lower interior horizontal, eyes confidently measuring the short parking space ahead. It rolls backward slightly to wind its spring, then releases. By 1.6 seconds it has raced across the ledge and overshot its intended stopping point. Its front wheels brake while its rear wheels keep spinning, launching it into one comically slow backward somersault within the open space between the two interior bars. At 2.6 seconds it lands upside down on the upper interior horizontal: all four wheels spin uselessly in the air, and its googly eyes swivel down toward the parking ledge it missed. Allow a short, silent reaction beat. A tiny springy chassis wiggle rights it; at 3.4 seconds it drops gently onto the lower ledge, finally stopping with all wheels planted. It gives one proud suspension bounce, then a last little spring release sends it rolling off the ledge and floating diagonally down and out of frame by 4.7 seconds. Keep its path within the openings or outside the sculpture, without crossing through strokes. The glyph never bends, moves or changes its construction.

By 4.8 seconds, the subtle surface dimples have softened away, leaving a crisp, uniformly indigo 月. Hold this single centered, uncropped glyph completely still through 8.0 seconds, with no other visible objects. Use bright, soft studio lighting, readable stroke gaps and gentle shadows.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin, saying exactly 「月、月、月亮」. Pronounce the first 月 at approximately 0.4 seconds, the second at 1.8 seconds, and 月亮 at 5.5–6.5 seconds during the clear final hold, using ㄩㄝˋ throughout. Leave natural pauses and stop after the word. Add quiet spring winding, rubber-wheel squeaks and a soft upside-down landing tap beneath the voice; use no music. The vocabulary is audio only. The sole on-screen writing is 月, with no subtitles, additional letters or numbers, logos, watermarks, clutter or flashing effects. All visible performance comes from the animated toy car and glyph sculpture.
